description.value: Stag's Head Liquor Store is a retail bottle shop situated inside City View Centre along the Princeton-Kamloops Highway on the eastern edge of Kamloops. It carries a broad selection of beer, wine, spirits, coolers, ciders, and snacks, including specialty items available on request. Delivery is offered through Skip the Dishes for those staying nearby.
